preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
A is a list of exactly N strings.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and s.islower() and 1 <= len(s) <= 20 for s in A)
preconditions.description: Every string in A consists of lowercase letters and has length between 1 and 20.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 1 if (all(A[i][0] == A[(i + 1) % N][-1] for i in range(N)) or any(all(A[perm[i]][0] == A[perm[(i + 1) % N]][-1] for i in range(N)) for perm in __import__('itertools').permutations(range(N)))) else 0
postconditions.description: Returns 1 if there exists a permutation of the strings such that the last character of each string matches the first character of the next string in the cycle (including the last to the first), forming a valid circle; otherwise returns 0.
